assumption_sentence: ASSUMPTION: distributed solar PV with battery storage in Guatemala costs the distributed (commercial rooftop) PV cost of each year multiplied by the ratio of utility-scale PV-plus-battery to utility-scale PV cost in the same year of the NREL Annual Technology Baseline (Moderate scenario, Market case): in 2024 capital 1794.74 x 1.5833 = 2841.5 USD/kW and fixed O&M 18.39 x 2.8446 = 52.30 USD/kW-yr, and in 2050 1570.1 USD/kW and 40.74 USD/kW-yr, for all model years (ATB 2021 ratios before 2022). Reason: a battery adds the same share of cost to a rooftop PV system as it adds to a utility-scale PV plant, so the utility-scale ratio carries over to distributed systems. Check: the EIA 2020 cost study prices utility-scale PV with storage at 1755 against 1313 USD/kW for PV alone (ratio 1.34) and fixed O&M at 31.27 against 15.25 USD/kW-yr (ratio 2.05). Range: capital ratio 1.34 to 1.58, about 2405 to 2842 USD/kW in 2024.
